name: com.eastwhiz.code-obfuscator
description: Pre-build source obfuscator for Unity projects: renames namespaces, classes, members, assemblies, folders, assets, shaders, scene objects and PlayerPrefs keys in place, keeps every by-name reference in sync, strips comments, scrubs studio / product names, never touches SDK folders, journals every change for one-click restore, and gates player builds until the project is obfuscated. Settings live in a per-project JSON profile that can be exported to the next project.
